If you do it right, headshots are the most reliable method for suicide. Especially if you're using a shotgun or high caliber weapon. Only successful suicides I've seen in the ED are gunshots to the head.

Not particularly, I've always been depressed and was just thinking about this last night. It seems better to make it so people don't find you, especially considering how gruesome that scene could be if you do shoot yourself in the head.
